item.title: Analyst Warns Against Using Microsoft's Copilot AI on Friday Afternoons
item.description: Given Copilot's dangerous hallucinations, an analyst suggests using it only when employees are alert enough to check its work.

item.title: Samples From Distant Asteroid Contain All DNA and RNA Building Blocks
item.description: Asteroid Ryugu appears to contain all the necessary ingredients to make the DNA and RNA underpinning life on Earth.

item.title: Microsoft Realizes It's Epically Screwed Up Windows 11 as Users Rage at Copilot AI Crammed Everywhere
item.description: Windows VP Pavan Davuluri effectively admitted outright that the company went too far to shove AI down users' throats at all costs.

item.title: Mark Zuckerberg Secretly Training an AI Agent to Do CEO Job
item.description: Meta CEO Mark Zuckeberg is reportedly building an CEO AI agent to help him to do his job, which is very hard.

item.title: Doctor Reels as Son Becomes Plumber in Age of AI
item.description: In a sign of the times, a doctor says she felt "guilty" when her son said he was going to become a plumber.

item.title: You’ll Snort-Laugh When You Learn How Much AI Actually Added to the US Economy Last Year
item.description: Consensus among financial analysts increasingly centers on the fact that AI hasn't contributed anything to GDP growth.

item.title: Man Pleads Guilty to Making $8 Million by Creating Music With AI and Using Bots to Drive Zillions of Fake Streams
item.description: A man has plead guilty for creating "hundreds of thousands of songs with AI" and using bots to make $8 million in royalties.

item.title: Sketchy Polymarket Accounts Making Suspicious Bets on Imminent Iran Ceasefire
item.description: A slew of new Polymarket accounts are betting big on an imminent ceasefire between the US and Iran, triggering the alarms.

item.title: Delivery Robot Allegedly Smashes Through Bus Stop Window, Keeps Driving Covered in Broken Glass
item.description: Footage shows a delivery robot showering a sidewalk with shattered glass after allegedly plowing through a bus shelter.

item.title: CEO Confronted Over Using AI to Clone Real People Without Their Consent
item.description: What would you do if it turned out a company was using your name and likeness to profit without your permission?

item.title: NASA Announces Nuclear Mission to Mars by 2028
item.description: NASA is putting Mars back in the crosshairs with a first-of-its-kind nuclear mission it says will launch by the end of 2028.

item.title: No, McDonald's Isn't Deploying Humanoid Robots as Workers in Shanghai
item.description: A video shows a uniformed robotic employee at a McDonald's in Shanghai, China greeting a patron while seemingly taking their order.
